40018058.author: पदार्थः
40018058.content: तौ the two, परस्परगतौ overcoming each other, बली powerful, शूरः heroes, सःतु he too, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, प्रसक्तौ fond of, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, युध्यमानौ intending to win in fight, प्रभिन्नौ broken to pieces, मातङ्गौइव like elephants, परस्परवधैषिणौ each of them for battle, नरराक्षसौ man and Rakshasa, दृष्टवाseeing, तयोः both, युद्धम् battle, द्रष्टुकामः eager to witness, सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तस्थौ stood

40018058.author: Translation
40018058.content: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.

40018059.author: पदार्थः
40018059.content: तौ the two, परस्परगतौ overcoming each other, बली powerful, शूरः heroes, सःतु he too, रावणभ्राता Ravana's brother, प्रसक्तौ fond of, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, युध्यमानौ intending to win in fight, प्रभिन्नौ broken to pieces, मातङ्गौइव like elephants, परस्परवधैषिणौ each of them for battle, नरराक्षसौ man and Rakshasa, दृष्टवाseeing, तयोः both, युद्धम् battle, द्रष्टुकामः eager to witness, सङ्ग्राममूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तस्थौ stood

40018059.author: Translation
40018059.content: Lakshmana (man) and Indrajith (Rakshasa) were fond of battle and intending to win in the fight overcoming each other. Each of them were like elephants but were broken into pieces. Vibheeshana, with eagerness to witness the battle stood in the forefront of the battlefield watching the fight.

40018059.author: सारांशः
40018059.content: Vibheeshana encourages Vanaras to fight against Rakshasas. Dreadful fight takes place between Lakshmana and Indrajith both releasing a volley of arrows. Charioteer of Indrajith gets killed by Lakshmana, the horses get killed by the Vanaras. Indrajith walks down desperately.

40018060.author: पदार्थः
40018060.content: ततः then, अवस्थितः stood, महत् great, धनुः bow, विष्फारयामास stretched, राक्षसेषु on Rakshasas, तीक्ष्णाग्रान् sharp pointed, महाशरान् great arrows, उत्ससर्ज च loosened.

40018060.author: Translation
40018060.content: Then Vibheeshana stood with stretched bow and loosened sharp pointed arrows on Rakshasas.

40018061.author: पदार्थः
40018061.content: समाहिताः settled, निपतन्तः fallen, शिखिसम्पर्शाः touching, ते those, शराः arrows, वज्राणि thunderbolts, महागिरीन् इव like mountain, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दारयामासुः split

40018061.author: Translation
40018061.content: Those burning arrows falling on Rakshasas touched the Rakshasas and split them like thunderbolt splitting mountains.

40018062.author: पदार्थः
40018062.content: विभीषणस्य Vibheeshana's, अनुचराः followers, ते those, राक्षसोत्तमाःअपि foremost of Rakshasa also, समरे in battle, वीरान् heroes, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, शूलासिपट्टस : pikes, swords and sharp edged spears, चिच्छिदुः shattered

40018062.author: Translation
40018062.content: Followers of Vibheeshana, the foremost of Rakshasa heroes, were shattered by the pikes, swords, and sharpedged spears in the battle.

40018063.author: पदार्थः
40018063.content: तदा then, तैः they, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परिवृतः surrounding, सःविभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रहृष्टानाम् delighted, कलभानाम् young elephants, मध्ये midst, द्विपःइव shone, बभौ remained

40018063.author: Translation
40018063.content: Vibheeshana surrounded by Rakshasas shone like an elephant in the midst of young elephants.

40018064.author: पदार्थः
40018064.content: ततः then, कालज्ञः knower of What was right at What time, रक्षसांवरः Rakshasa, काले time, रक्षोरणप्रियान् who were eager to fight with Rakshasas, हरीन् Vanaras, स्संञ्चोदयामास emboldening, वचनम् words, उवाचवै spoke

40018064.author: Translation
40018064.content: Then Vibheeshana, who is a knower of what is the right time to act spoke to Vanaras to embolden them who were eager to fight with Rakshasas.

40018065.author: पदार्थः
40018065.content: हरीश्वराः Vanara leaders, अयम् this, एकः only one, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa's king's, परायणम् gone, अवस्थितः is there, तस्य his, बलम् army, एतच्छेषम् left, किम् why, तिष्ठत stand idle

40018065.author: Translation
40018065.content: "Oh Vanara leaders! He (Indrajith) is the only one who is left in the Rakshasa army. Why do you stand idle?"

40018066.author: पदार्थः
40018066.content: रणमूर्थनि in the forefront of battle, पापे wicked, अस्मिन् in his, राक्षसे raksasas, विनिहते struck down, रावणम् Ravana, वर्जयित्वा leaving, अस्य his, शेषम् left, बलम् army, हतम् killed

40018066.author: Translation
40018066.content: "If this wicked Rakshasa is struck down, except Ravana all his army is killed."

40018067.author: पदार्थः
40018067.content: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka

40018067.author: Translation
40018067.content: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

40018068.author: पदार्थः
40018068.content: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka

40018068.author: Translation
40018068.content: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

40018069.content: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka

40018069.author: Translation
40018069.content: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

40018070.author: पदार्थः
40018070.content: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka

40018070.author: Translation
40018070.content: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

40018071.author: पदार्थः
40018071.content: प्रहस्तः Prahastha, निहतः killed, वीरः hero, निकुम्भश्च Nikumbha also, महाबलः of great prowess, कुम्भकर्णश्च Kumbhakarna also, कुम्भश्च Kumbha aslo, धूम्राक्षः Dhum raksha, निशाचरः night ranger, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महामाली Mahamali, तीक्ष्णवेगः Teekshnavega, अशनिभ्रः Asanibhra, सुप्तघ्नः Suptagna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yagna kopa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सम्ह्रादी Samhadri, अरिघ्नः Arigna, विकटः Vikata, तपनः Tapana, दमएव च Dama also, प्रघासः Praghasa, प्रघसIश्चैव Praghasa, प्रजङ्घ Prajangha:, जङञःएव च Jangha also, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च Agniketha also, वीर्यवान् heroes, रश्मिकेतुश्च Rasmikethu, विद्युज्जिह्व Vidyajihva, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihwa, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, अकम्पनः Akampana, सुपार्श्वश्च Suparswa, चक्रमाली Chakramali, राक्षसश्च Rakshasas, कम्पनः Kampana, सत्त्ववन्तौ energetic, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka

40018071.author: Translation
40018071.content: "The heroic Prahastha, Nikumbha also and Kumbhakarna of mighty prowess, Kumbha also, night ranger Dum raksha, Jambumali, Mahamali, Teekshanavega, Asanibhra, Suptanga, Yagnakopa, Vajradamshtra, Rakshasas Simhadri, Arigna, Vikata, Tapana, Dama also, Praghaasa, Praghasa, Prajaghna, and Jaghan also, Durdarsha, Agniketha, heroes Rasmikethu, Vidyajihva, Dwijihwa, Suryasatru, and Rakshasas Akampana, Suparswa, Chakramali, and Rakshasas Kampana, and energetic Devanthaka and Naranthaka have been killed by you."

40018072.author: पदार्थः
40018072.content: अतिबलान् exceeding might, एतान् all of them, बहून् many, राक्षससत्तमान् leaders of Rakshasas, निहत्य killed, बाहुभ्याम् many, सागरम् ocean, तीर्त्वा swum, लघु small, गोष्पदम् hoof mark of cowलङ्घ्यताम् cross without delay

40018072.author: Translation
40018072.content: "You have made short of many exceedingly mighty leaders of Rakshasas and swum the ocean. You cross this hoof mark of a cow without delay."

40018073.author: पदार्थः
40018073.content: वानराः Vanara, वः only, इह, nowजेतव्यम् to be conquered, एतावदेव remains, शेषम् left over, बलदर्पिताः proud of their might, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समागम्य meeting, हताःkilled

40018073.author: Translation
40018073.content: "O Vanaras! Left over Rakshasas only to be conquered now. Rakshasas, who were proud of their might have been killed on meeting you."

40018074.author: पदार्थः
40018074.content: जनितुः father, मम my, पुत्रस्य son like, निधनम् striking, कर्तुम् will do, अयुक्तम् not proper, रामार्धे for the sake of Rama, घृणाम् taking pity, अपास्य helpless, भ्रातुः brother, आत्मजम् my son, निहन्याम् take out life

40018074.author: Translation
40018074.content: "For the sake of Rama, I will strike my brother's son. Being a father, taking pity, I am helpless as it is not proper for me to take the life of my son."

40018075.author: पदार्थः
40018075.content: हन्तुकामस्य wish to kill, मे my, चक्षुः eyes, बाष्पम् tears, निरुध्यति clouding, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, एषः so, लक्ष्मणःएव Lakshmana, तमशमयिष्यति will kill him, वानराःVanara, सम्भूय collected, अस्य to him, समीपगान् coming near, भृत्यान् attendants, घ्नत destroy

40018075.author: Translation
40018075.content: "I wish to kill him, tears are clouding my eyes. Mighty armed Lakshmana will kill him. Vanaras collected together are coming near him and can destroy his attendants."

40018076.author: पदार्थः
40018076.content: इति thus, अतियशसा encouraging, तेन by that, राक्षसेन Rakshasa, अभिचोदिताः incited, वानरेन्द्राःVanara chiefs जहृषिरे rejoiced, लाङ्गूलानि shaking their tails, विव्यधुः च went swiftly

40018076.author: Translation
40018076.content: Incited by the encouraging words of Vibheeshana (Rakshasa), Vanara chiefs rejoiced and went shaking their tails.

40018077.author: पदार्थः
40018077.content: ततः then, कपिशार्दूलाः tigers among monkeys, पुनःपुनः again and again, श्रवेड़न्तःश्च roaring, मेघान् clouds, दृष्टवा seen, बर्हिणःइव like peacocks, विविधान् several, नादान् sounds, मुमुचुः made

40018077.author: Translation
40018077.content: Then the tigers among monkeys again and again roaring in seeing the clouds made several kinds of sounds like peacocks.

40018078.author: पदार्थः
40018078.content: सर्वैः all, तैः of them, सयूथ्यैः troops, अभिसम्वृतः surrounded, जाम्बवानपि Jambavan, ते they, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, आश्मभिः their, नकैः nails, दन्स्सैश्च and teeth, ताडयामासुः pierced

40018078.author: Translation
40018078.content: All the troops surrounded by Jambavan too, pierced the Rakshasas with their nails and teeth.

40018079.author: पदार्थः
40018079.content: महाबलाः endowed with mighty strength, तेराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, अनेकविधायुधाः different kinds of weapons, निघ्नन्तम् striking, तंऋक्षाधिपतिम् the Lord of Bears, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा giving up, परिवव्रुः surrounded

40018079.author: Translation
40018079.content: The Rakshasas who were endowed with mighty strength giving up fear, armed with different kinds of weapons surrounded Jambavan, the Lord of Bears.

40018080.author: पदार्थः
40018080.content: मृधे, राक्षसीम् Rakshasas, चमूम् army, निघ्नन्तम् destroying, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, शरैः arrows, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, परशुभिः axes, पट्टिशैः iron bars, यष्टितोमरैः sharpedged spears, जघ्नुः assailed

40018080.author: Translation
40018080.content: The Rakshasas then assailed Jambvan who was destroying the Rakshasa army with axes, pointed arrows, iron bars and sharpedged spears.

40018081.author: पदार्थः
40018081.content: कपिरक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, सः they, तुमुलः vehement, महास्वनः in loud clamour, भीमः fearful, सः they, सम्प्रहार battle, क्रुद्धानां enraged, देवासुराणांयथा like the battle of Devas and asuras, सञ्जज्ञे took place

40018081.author: Translation
40018081.content: Fearful and vehement battle took place between enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas making loud clamours like the battle (in the past) between Devas and asuras.

40018082.author: पदार्थः
40018082.content: महामनाः great self, सःहनुमानपि Hanuman too, सङ्क्रुद्धः very furious, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, स्वयम् himself, पृष्ठात् back, अवरोप्य dismount, पर्वतात् from a mountain, सानुम्Sala tree, उत्पाट्य uprooted, समासाद्य thousands, सहस्रशः thousands, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasa, कदनम् exterminate, चक्रे went on

40018082.author: Translation
40018082.content: Great selfHanuman too became furious and dismounting Lakshmana from his back uprooted a sala tree from a mountain and went on exterminating thousands of Rakshasas.

40018083.author: पदार्थः
40018083.content: महामनाः great self, सःहनुमानपि Hanuman too, सङ्क्रुद्धः very furious, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, स्वयम् himself, पृष्ठात् back, अवरोप्य dismount, पर्वतात् from a mountain, सानुम्Sala tree, उत्पाट्य uprooted, समासाद्य thousands, सहस्रशः thousands, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasa, कदनम् exterminate, चक्रे went on

40018083.author: Translation
40018083.content: Great selfHanuman too became furious and dismounting Lakshmana from his back uprooted a sala tree from a mountain and went on exterminating thousands of Rakshasas.

40018084.author: पदार्थः
40018084.content: बली mighty, परवीरघ्नः who can give tough fight to enemies, सःइन्द्रजित् that Indrajith, पितृव्यस्य father's brother, तुमुलम् violent, युद्धम् fight, दत्त्वा giving, पुनरेव again, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अभ्यधावत् rushed towards

40018084.author: Translation
40018084.content: Mighty Indrajith who can give tough fight to enemies gave a violent fight to his father's brother and again rushed towards Lakshmana.

40018085.author: पदार्थः
40018085.content: मृधे bear, प्रयुद्धौ in that battle, तौ those two, वीरौ heroes, लक्ष्मणराक्षसौ Lakshmana and Rakshasa, शरौघान् streams of arrows, अभिवर्षन्तौ raining on each, तौ the two, परस्परम् one another, जघ्नतुःengaged in battle

40018085.author: Translation
40018085.content: In that battle the two heroes, Lakshmana and Indrajith rained streams of arrows on each other and engaged themselves in the battle.

40018086.author: पदार्थः
40018086.content: महाबलौ mighty, तरस्विनौ energetic, उष्णान्ते after summer, मेघैः clouds, चन्द्रादित्याविवयथा like moon and Sun, शरजालैः net of arrows, अभीक्षणम् frequently, अन्तर्धधतुः are veiled

40018086.author: Translation
40018086.content: Both the mighty and energetic heroes, covered each other with arrows just as after summer the moon and Sun are veiled frequently by clouds.

40018087.author: पदार्थः
40018087.content: तत्र there, युध्यतो while fighting in battle, तयोः both, पाणिलाघवात् due to quickness of hand movement, धनुषः bow, परिग्रहःवा taking out or, न अदृश्यत drawing out, बाणानाम् arrows from the quiver, आदानम् seizing, न हि not clear, सन्धानम् aiming, न not, विप्रमोक्षः shot, न विकर्षः not drawing, नor, विग्रहः stretching out, न or, मुष्टिप्रतिसन्धानम् fixing with fist, न or, लक्ष्यप्रतिपादनम् hitting the target, न or not

40018087.author: Translation
40018087.content: While both were fighting, due to the quickness of their hand movement, it could not be perceived whether they were taking out arrows from the quiver, drawing the string, or seizing arrows, or aiming to shoot or not. Whether they were drawing or stretching the bow or not or fixing with their fist or hitting the target or not, was not clear.

40018088.author: पदार्थः
40018088.content: तत्र there, युध्यतो while fighting in battle, तयोः both, पाणिलाघवात् due to quickness of hand movement, धनुषः bow, परिग्रहःवा taking out or, न अदृश्यत drawing out, बाणानाम् arrows from the quiver, आदानम् seizing, न हि not clear, सन्धानम् aiming, न not, विप्रमोक्षः shot, न विकर्षः not drawing, नor, विग्रहः stretching out, न or, मुष्टिप्रतिसन्धानम् fixing with fist, न or, लक्ष्यप्रतिपादनम् hitting the target, न or not

40018088.author: Translation
40018088.content: While both were fighting, due to the quickness of their hand movement, it could not be perceived whether they were taking out arrows from the quiver, drawing the string, or seizing arrows, or aiming to shoot or not. Whether they were drawing or stretching the bow or not or fixing with their fist or hitting the target or not, was not clear.

40018089.author: पदार्थः
40018089.content: चापवेगप्रयुक्स्सैः discharging from the bow swiftly, बाणजालैः net of arrows, समन्ततः all over, अन्तरिक्षे the sky, अभिसम्पन्ने covered, रूपाणि object, न चकाशिरे could be seen

40018089.author: Translation
40018089.content: As they were discharging arrows from the bow swiftly, the arrows formed a net covering all over the sky and no object could be visible.

40018090.author: पदार्थः
40018090.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रावणिम् Indrajith, प्राप्य meeting, रावणिश्चापि Indrajith also, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्राप्य reaching, ताभ्याम् both, अन्योन्यविग्रहे one another stretching, उग्रा in front, अव्यवस्था confusion, भवति prevailed

40018090.author: Translation
40018090.content: As Lakshmana was meeting Indrajith and Indrajith was reaching out to Lakshmana, confusion prevailed about who was hitting whom?

40018091.author: पदार्थः
40018091.content: ताभ्याम् both of them, उभाभ्याम् one over the other, तरसा swiftly, प्रसृष्टैः extended, शितैः whetted, विशिखैः arrows, निरन्तरमिव continuously, आकाशम् the sky, तमसा dark, वृम् shrouded, बभूव became

40018091.author: Translation
40018091.content: while both of them one over the other swiftly extended and loosened the whetted arrows continuously, the sky, shrouded with arrows, became dark.

40018092.author: पदार्थः
40018092.content: पतभदिः falling, शितैः pointed, बहुभिः many, तयोः the two, शरशतैः hundreds of arrows, दिशश्च directions, प्रदिशश्च intermediate directions, शरसङ्कुलाः arrows spread, बभूवुः many

40018092.author: Translation
40018092.content: Many hundreds of pointed arrows falling in all directions and intermediate points spread all over.

40018093.author: पदार्थः
40018093.content: सर्वम् everything, तमसा darkness, पिहितम् enveloped, महत् great, प्रतिभयम् dreadful appearance, आसीत् exists, सहस्रांशो thousand rays, अस्तंगते sinks down, तमसा darkness, सम्वृते envelops, सहस्रशः thousands, रुधिरौघमहानद्यः blood streams, प्रावर्तन्त flowed

40018093.author: Translation
40018093.content: As the sun sank down, darkness enveloped, everything was dark and dreadful in appearance. Streams of blood of thousands flowed.

40018094.author: पदार्थः
40018094.content: दारुणाः frightful, क्रव्यादाः cries of carnivorous animals, वाग्भि: their tongues, भीमनिःस्वनान् frightening sounds, चिक्षिपुःemitted, तदानीम्, वायुः wind, न वनौ not blew, पावकः च fire, न जज्वाल not glowed

40018094.author: Translation
40018094.content: Carnivorous animals cried frightfully with their tongues. Wind did not blow, the fire did not glow.

40018095.author: पदार्थः
40018095.content: लोकेभ्यः worlds, स्वस्तिwell, अस्तु be, इति thus, ते to you, महर्षयः sages, जजल्पुः murmured, सन्तप्ताः worried, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, चारणैःसह Charanas, अत्र there, सम्पेतुः went distressed

40018095.author: Translation
40018095.content: Sages murmured saying" may this world be well." Gandharvas, Charanas (who came to see the battle) went distressed.

40018096.author: पदार्थः
40018096.content: अथ and then, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, राक्षससिंहस्य lion of Rakshasas, कनकभूषणान् decked in gold, कृष्णान् black, चतुरः four, हयान् horses, चतुर्भिः all the four, शरैः with shafts, विव्याध finished

40018096.author: Translation
40018096.content: Then Saumithri pierced with four shafts all the four black horses decked in gold, of the lion of Rakshasas (Indrajith) and finished them

40018097.author: पदार्थः
40018097.content: ततः then, श्रीमान् glorious, सःराघवः Raghava, पीतेन glowing, निशितेन च pointed, सम्पूर्णायुतमुक्तेन released with full force, सुपत्रेण beautiful plumes, सुवर्छसा splendid, महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, तलशब्दानुनादिना resounded with hilt of the sword, भल्लेन bhalla, तेन by that, आपरेण to remove, बाणाशनिना with arrows, विचरिष्यतः driving in circles, सूतस्य charioteer, शिरः head, लाघवात् easily, कायात् body, अपाहरत् severed

40018097.author: Translation
40018097.content: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

40018098.author: पदार्थः
40018098.content: ततः then, श्रीमान् glorious, सःराघवः Raghava, पीतेन glowing, निशितेन च pointed, सम्पूर्णायुतमुक्तेन released with full force, सुपत्रेण beautiful plumes, सुवर्छसा splendid, महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, तलशब्दानुनादिना resounded with hilt of the sword, भल्लेन bhalla, तेन by that, आपरेण to remove, बाणाशनिना with arrows, विचरिष्यतः driving in circles, सूतस्य charioteer, शिरः head, लाघवात् easily, कायात् body, अपाहरत् severed

40018098.author: Translation
40018098.content: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

40018099.author: पदार्थः
40018099.content: ततः then, श्रीमान् glorious, सःराघवः Raghava, पीतेन glowing, निशितेन च pointed, सम्पूर्णायुतमुक्तेन released with full force, सुपत्रेण beautiful plumes, सुवर्छसा splendid, महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, तलशब्दानुनादिना resounded with hilt of the sword, भल्लेन bhalla, तेन by that, आपरेण to remove, बाणाशनिना with arrows, विचरिष्यतः driving in circles, सूतस्य charioteer, शिरः head, लाघवात् easily, कायात् body, अपाहरत् severed

40018099.author: Translation
40018099.content: Then glorious Raghava with pointed bhalla furnished with beautiful plumes, splendid, deadly as Indra's thunderbolt, released and as it resounded the hit of the sword and severed the head from the body of the charioteer, who was driving in circles.

40018100.author: पदार्थः
40018100.content: यन्तरि charioteer, हते killed, महातेजाः brilliant, सः he, मन्दोदरीसुतः Indrajith (son of Mandodari), स्वयम् himself, सारथ्यम्? driving the chariot, अकरोत् role of charioteer, पुनश्च again, धनुः bow, अस्पृशत् wielded

40018100.author: Translation
40018100.content: When the charioteer got killed, the brilliant son of Mandodari, played the role of charioteer and wielded the bow again.

40018101.author: पदार्थः
40018101.content: युधि in battle, तत्र there, तत् that, सामर्थ्यम् capacity, पश्यताम् onlookers, तत् those, अद्भुतम् wonder, अभूत् created, हयेषु horses also, व्यग्रहस्तम् holding in hand, तम् them, निशितैः pointed, शरैः arrows, विव्याध assailed, अत then, पुनःagain, धनुषि bow, व्यग्रे occupied, हयेषु with horses, शरान् arrows, मुमुचे loosened

40018101.author: Translation
40018101.content: While Indrajith was engaged with the horses in one hand and battling, his capacity was a wonder to the onlookers. Lakshmana again attacked him loosening pointed arrows at him while Indrajith was busy with his bow.

40018102.author: पदार्थः
40018102.content: शीघ्रकृत्तमः one who acts with extreme alacrity, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, समरे in battle, अभीतवत् fearless, विचरन्तम् moving, तेषु that way, छिद्रेषु easily pierced, बाणौघैः with arrows अर्धयामास moving to hurt

40018102.author: Translation
40018102.content: While Indrajith was moving undaunted being hurt, Lakshmana who acts with extreme alacrity and fearless easily pierced Indrajith with arrows.

40018103.author: पदार्थः
40018103.content: सःरावणात्मजः Ravana's son, समरे in the battle, निहतम् killed, सारथिम् charioteer, दृष्टवा seeing, समरोद्धर्षम् enthusiasm to fight, प्रजहौ people, विषण्णः despondent, बभूव grew

40018103.author: Translation
40018103.content: Seeing the charioteer killed, Ravana's son was despondent and lost enthusiasm to fight (said people).

40018104.author: पदार्थः
40018104.content: हरियूथपाः Vanara leaders, विषण्णवदनम् worried face, राक्षसम् of Rakshasa, दृष्टवा seeing, ततः then, परमसम्हृष्टाः very joyful, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अभ्यपूजयन् acclaimed

40018104.author: Translation
40018104.content: The Vanara leaders were joyful upon seeing the worried face of the Rakshasa and acclaimed Lakshmana.

40018105.author: पदार्थः
40018105.content: ततः then, प्रमाथीः Pramati, रभसः Rabahasa, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, चत्वारः exhibited, हरीश्वराः Lord of monkeys, अमृष्यमाणाः intolerant, वेगम् quickly, चक्रुः went

40018105.author: Translation
40018105.content: Then the four monkey leaders, Pramati, Rabahasa, Sarabha, and Gandamadhana exhibited their intolerance and went quickly.

40018106.author: पदार्थः
40018106.content: सुमहावीर्याः of remarkable valour, भीमविक्रमाः of terrible courage, ते they, वानराः Vanaras, तूर्णम् immediately, उत्पत्य getting up, अस्य those, हयमुख्येषु best of horses, निपेतुः fell

40018106.author: Translation
40018106.content: The four Vanaras of remarkable valour and of terrific courage getting up immediately fell on the best of the horses (of Indrajith).

40018107.author: पदार्थः
40018107.content: पर्वतोपमैः huge as mountains, तैःवानरैः those Vanaras, अधिष्ठितानाम् getting on top, तेषांहयानाम् of those horses, मुखेभ्य mouths, रक्तम् blood, रुदिरम् red, समवर्तत flowed

40018107.author: Translation
40018107.content: Those Vanaras of huge mountain forms getting on top of those horses (of Indrajith),

40018108.author: पदार्थः
40018108.content: मथिताः mutilated, तेहयाः those horses, भग्नाः broken, व्यसवः sank, धरणीम् into earth, गताः went, ते they, तस्य their, हयान् horses, निहत्य killed, महारथम् great chariot, प्रमथ्य च bounding, पुनः again, वेगेन quickly, उत्पत्य getting up, लक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः nearby Lakshmana, तस्थुः stood

40018108.author: Translation
40018108.content: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.

40018109.author: पदार्थः
40018109.content: मथिताः mutilated, तेहयाः those horses, भग्नाः broken, व्यसवः sank, धरणीम् into earth, गताः went, ते they, तस्य their, हयान् horses, निहत्य killed, महारथम् great chariot, प्रमथ्य च bounding, पुनः again, वेगेन quickly, उत्पत्य getting up, लक्ष्मणपार्श्वतः nearby Lakshmana, तस्थुः stood

40018109.author: Translation
40018109.content: The horses were mutilated, broken, and sunk into the earth and killed. Again, bounding the great chariot, they got up quickly and stood nearby Lakshmana.

40018110.author: पदार्थः
40018110.content: हतसारथिः charioteer dead, सःरावणिः that Indrajith, हताश्वात् horses killed, रथात् chariot, अवप्लुत्य leaping down, शरवर्षेण by raining arrows, सौमित्रिम् at Saumithri, अभ्यधावत assailed

40018110.author: Translation
40018110.content: Charioteer dead, horses killed that Indrajith leapt down and assailed Lakshmana by raining arrows.
